steps: Go to https://sofi.com/banking/checking-offer/ and tap 'Open an account' to start a SoFi Checking and Savings application (or start it in the SoFi app).
Complete the application with your name, address, Social Security number, and a valid photo ID.
Once approved, find your SoFi account and routing numbers in the app under your checking account details.
Give those numbers to your employer's payroll (or pension/benefits provider) to set up direct deposit — it must be real payroll/pension/government ACH, not a transfer from another bank or app.
Make sure your first eligible direct deposit of at least $1 arrives on or before 12/31/26 — this starts your 25-calendar-day bonus measurement window.
Within those 25 calendar days, get your total eligible direct deposits to at least $1,000 ($50 bonus) or $5,000+ ($400 bonus).
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus lands in your SoFi Checking account within 7 business days after the requirements are complete.
timing: Bonus deposited within 7 business days of completing all requirements. The 25-calendar-day measurement window starts at the first eligible direct deposit of $1 or more.
